name: read_webpage
description: Fetch a web page and extract its readable content (title, text/markdown/html/raw). Optionally scope to a CSS selector, strip boilerplate, or write to a file. No sandboxing.

url.description: Absolute http/https URL to fetch (redirects are followed).

output_path.description: If given, write extracted content to this file and return only metadata, not the text.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to scope extraction to a single element.

max_chars.description: Truncate extracted content to this many characters.

strip_boilerplate.description: Remove nav/footer/aside/header/form for a reader view (default true). Ignored when selector is set.
